title: Puharich's journal records a day with Townsend Brown in DC

tellings.quote: journals, he mentions um meeting Townsend Brown >> [laughter] >> and spending the day with him.

plain: Andrija Puharich, the scientist at the centre of the episode, wrote in his private journals of meeting a man named Thomas Townsend Brown in Washington, DC, in 1953 and spending the day with him. A researcher on the show, who is not named, mentions this from the journals, to the laughter of the room, as a sign that the two men's paths crossed.
